# SNN_NonIdeality_Modeling

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The explicit representation of analog circuit imperfections (e.g., charge injection, offset, thermal noise) within SNN simulation, enabling realistic performance prediction. Critical for predicting real-world behavior of neuromorphic accelerators in network nodes, where signal integrity directly impacts spike-based computation.
